================================================================
A statement follows an if without an else
================================================================

    if (lost) return Failed(IOException("gone"))
    uploaded = blob
}

  (function_declaration
    (simple_identifier)
    (function_value_parameters)
    (function_body
      (block
        (statements
          (if_expression
            (simple_identifier)
            (jump_expression
              (postfix_expression
                (simple_identifier)
                (postfix_unary_suffix
                  (call_suffix
                    (value_arguments
                      (value_argument
                        (postfix_expression
                          (simple_identifier)
                          (postfix_unary_suffix
                            (call_suffix
                              (value_arguments
                                (value_argument
                                  (string_literal
                                    (line_string_literal))))))))))))))
          (assignment
            (simple_identifier)
            (simple_identifier)))))))

================================================================

================================================================

    else {
        c()
    }

                      (value_arguments))))))))))))
